events.name: The Standing Light
events.what_appears: A single warm yellow light, like a flashlight, standing still between trees. No person visible.
events.behavior: Stays perfectly still, then dims out and relights 20 m to the left, never moving between.

leave_triggers.looked_at_directly: Light winks out and does not return for the night.
leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars show only a lantern-like glow with no bearer; it winks out after 3 s.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Bullet does nothing. Light relights closer (tier-up penalty, see escalation).
leave_triggers.ignored: Relights two more times, each 100 m closer, then stops.

events.design_note: Teaches the player to scan. Harmless on its own; the first hint someone else is out there.

events.name: Rangers' Truck, Wrong Road
events.what_appears: Pair of headlights moving on the forest road, no engine sound at all.
events.behavior: Rolls slowly along the road, stops at the cabin turn-off, lights go off. Radio call afterwards says no vehicles are out.

leave_triggers.looked_at_directly: Lights switch off the moment you face them.
leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars: no truck, just two lights floating at hood height.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Nothing; shots are too far. Wastes ammo.
leave_triggers.ignored: Lights reach the turn-off and go dark.

events.design_note: Sets up the radio lie later.

events.name: Owl That Isn't
events.what_appears: An owl call that repeats with exactly the same timing every time, coming from the balcony railing side, no bird.
events.behavior: Sound-only event. After four identical calls the sixth sounds almost like a word.

leave_triggers.looked_at_directly: Looking over the rail stops it instantly.
leave_triggers.ignored: Continues, slowly shifting to the stairwell side.

events.name: The Tall Pale Shape
events.what_appears: A pale vertical shape at the edge of the clearing, a little too tall to be a person.
events.behavior: Stands motionless facing the tower. Each time the player looks away and back it is a few meters nearer, but never seen moving.

leave_triggers.looked_at_directly: Freezes. Looking away lets it advance 5 m.
leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars show a thin figure with no visible face, arms too long; it steps behind a trunk.
leave_triggers.shot_at: One shot: it drops from view and a branch snaps below the tower 10 s later. Does not die. Costs 1 round and teaches that shots don't solve it.
leave_triggers.ignored: Advances to 120 m then stops and leaves.

events.design_note: Signature slow-burn creature. Statue-style rule, no jump scare.

events.name: Cabin Window Curtain
events.what_appears: A light comes on in the abandoned Hale cabin; a figure shapes behind the curtain.
events.behavior: Silhouette in the window raises a hand as if waving. Curtain slides across. Another window lights.

leave_triggers.looked_at_directly: All lights go off at once.
leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars show the cabin is boarded and the curtain moves with no one there.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Window shatters faintly; the silhouette in the next window is still waving.

events.design_note: Cabins were 'closed' per the station log.

events.name: Knocking From Below
events.what_appears: Three slow knocks on the tower's lowest landing, then silence, repeated at longer intervals.
events.behavior: Sound-only. Knocks get closer to the trap door in the cab floor. The pattern copies the player's own door close timing.

leave_triggers.looked_at_directly: Looking over the balcony shows nothing; knocks pause 20 s.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Shooting down through the gaps wastes a round; knocking resumes from the other side.
leave_triggers.ignored: After 6 sets the knocks stop and footsteps climb 3 steps then stop.

events.design_note: Stairs are blocked, but the sound is the player's anxiety.

events.name: Lake Swimmer
events.what_appears: A head and shoulders in the black lake, moving across it without ripples.
events.behavior: Swims to the middle, turns to face the tower, then sinks straight down without a splash.

leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars show something pale, with water streaming up its back.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Too far; shot echoes across the lake and animals go silent for 20 s.
leave_triggers.ignored: Stays still until the timer, then sinks.

events.name: Elk Wrong
events.what_appears: A bull elk in a meadow, standing too still, head hanging oddly.
events.behavior: Elk stands facing the tower. Then its head rotates slowly further than should be possible. Returns to normal when looked at.

leave_triggers.looked_at_directly: Looks away normally and walks off.
leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars show the neck bent backwards and eyes reflecting green.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Shot makes the elk collapse, then stand again and walk into the trees. Rewards no kills.

events.name: Coyote Chorus Stops
events.what_appears: Coyotes howl across the valley, then all stop in the same instant. A very human scream follows.
events.behavior: Audio-led. A pale shape moves along the valley floor fast, too far to resolve.

leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars catch a blur crossing a clearing, then nothing.

events.name: The Watcher on the Ridge
events.what_appears: Silhouette on the opposing ridge line against the sky, perfectly framed.
events.behavior: Stands there all night in the background. Each hour it is slightly more to the left. If the lookout waves, it waves back after a delay.

leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars show a figure in a ranger's hat and jacket.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Out of effective range; shot causes it to wave faster.

events.design_note: Long-duration ambient horror. Threat is the ranger's hat.

events.name: Whistle Answer
events.what_appears: The player's radio click is answered by a whistle from the woods, same tone.
events.behavior: Whistle from the treeline, then again from a closer spot on the other side of the tower.

leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars show nothing at the source.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Shooting at the sound draws a reply, now from below.
leave_triggers.ignored: Whistle triangulates until it is right under the cab.

events.name: Below the Tower: Footprints
events.what_appears: Wet footprints appear on the lowest visible landing, leading up then turning around.
events.behavior: Player glances over the balcony and sees prints which weren't there before. Each night, one more landing up.

leave_triggers.shot_at: Shooting at the base does nothing.
leave_triggers.ignored: Next night, prints go one landing higher.

events.name: Two Figures, One Shadow
events.what_appears: Two figures standing in the road holding each other, with one shadow between them.
events.behavior: Stand still, then slowly lean toward the tower in unison.

leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars: faces smeared as if photographed in motion.
leave_triggers.shot_at: One drops; the other stays and tilts its head. One round used.
leave_triggers.ignored: Close-ups of faces appear on next glance.

events.name: The Door Moves
events.what_appears: Cab door unlatches itself and swings open a hand's width. Cold air pours in.
events.behavior: Door opens then closes slowly. Voice from the balcony says the lookout's name in the station voice.

leave_triggers.looked_at_directly: Looking at the door does nothing; it opens when the player looks away.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Shooting out the door yields only a splintered frame.

events.design_note: The one close event. Rare, sudden, short.

events.name: The Far Bonfire
events.what_appears: A campfire on the opposite ridge, with a ring of standing shapes around it.
events.behavior: Shapes stand facing out. One slowly points at the tower. Fire goes out and every figure turns.

leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars: dozens of figures, all with hats like the lookouts.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Out of range; shape still points.

events.name: Treeline Closing In
events.what_appears: In the clearing, the pale shape from ev04 has been joined by others; each appears in a different spot every time the lookout blinks (lens vignette).
events.behavior: Slow approach, never seen moving. Never more than 60 m away.

leave_triggers.seen_through_binoculars: Binoculars show the same face on each.
leave_triggers.shot_at: Shot makes one retreat; the rest advance. Maximum one round suggested.

events.design_note: Climax. Shooting is a choice with no payoff.

events.name: Station Voice Outside
events.what_appears: The ranger station's voice calls from below the tower asking the lookout to come down.
events.behavior: Voice sounds identical to the dispatcher. Repeats for 40 s. Radio reports dispatcher at base.

leave_triggers.shot_at: Shooting down causes silence for 30 s, then voice returns in a whisper.

events.name: Dawn Count
events.what_appears: At first light, all shapes visible for one second: the clearing is full. Then fog.
events.behavior: Fog rolls in, shapes vanish. Reveal sequence for night end.

events.name: Branch Snaps in the Dark
events.what_appears: Sticks snapping under the tower in a pattern that circles it.

leave_triggers.shot_at: Shot toward it: laughter in the trees.

within_a_night.note: Only wind_loop, owl, one far light. Calm.
Events pair up; two at once with sound from below.
Silence in the ambience, then one tier-3 or 4 event.
Everything backs off; fog; birds return. Dawn screen.

escalation.ammo_rules: No event requires shooting. No event spawns more than 1 hostile that can be shot. Shots never kill; they redirect events. Max cost 1 round per event; players can also gain nothing. Rewards for restraint: some events end faster if ignored.
escalation.scheduler: Weights: tier-1 weight 5, tier-2 weight 3, tier-3 weight 2, tier-4 weight 1; min 90 s gap; never repeat the same event twice in a night.
